query: How can support teams reduce ticket resolution time?

per_column.name: issue_type_category
per_column.rationale: The type of issue is an immutable property of the ticket that affects both what resolution action is needed and the resolution time; a pre-existing common cause, not an intervenable lever.

per_column.name: has_blocker_or_dependency
per_column.rationale: Presence of blockers/dependencies is a pre-existing condition of the ticket that drives both the required resolution path and resolution time; it is not something support teams freely set, so it functions as a confounder rather than a treatment.

per_column.name: urgency_indicator
per_column.rationale: Urgency is an intrinsic attribute of the ticket that influences prioritization/action and resolution time; a common cause, not a settable intervention.

per_column.name: technical_root_cause_domain
per_column.rationale: The underlying technical root cause is a fixed property of the incident affecting both the action taken and the time to resolve; not an intervenable lever.

per_column.name: resolution_action_required
per_column.rationale: The resolution action/escalation path is something a support team can actually decide or set (escalate, self-serve, configure), making it the one plausibly intervenable treatment on the outcome. However it is arguably a mediator between issue characteristics and time; it is the closest thing to an actionable lever.

judge.rationale: The query 'How can support teams reduce ticket resolution time?' is genuinely interventional: it asks what levers reduce the outcome. Only resolution_action_required is a plausibly intervenable treatment (an actor can choose the escalation/handling path), and it is not named in the query. The other four columns are pre-existing ticket attributes (issue type, blockers, urgency, root cause) that serve as confounders / common causes affecting both the chosen action and resolution time, and none were named in the query, which is a point in the schema's favor. Weaknesses: the treatment is largely a description of what was done rather than a cleanly settable policy, and it can behave as a mediator downstream of the issue attributes; the 'confounders' partly determine the treatment mechanistically (bordering on mediator ambiguity). Thus the intervention is set up but not cleanly, yielding moderate confounder quality.
